CREDITS

APEX DRIFT

GAME & ENGINE

Design, code, art and audio by the Apex Drift fleet

Built on three.js r128 — MIT licence, with thanks to its authors and community

THE WORLD

Deserts, canyons, alpine passes, tundra, glaciers, volcanoes and crater lakes

Wind farms, monasteries, observatories, lighthouses, drive-in cinemas and one very large robot

THE TRAFFIC

Sedans, bikes, buses, trucks, emergency vehicles, convoys, processions and panic stops

They indicate, swerve, pull over and sometimes honk back

MODES & EVENTS

23 game modes, seasonal worlds, weekly modifier days, login calendars and birthday cake

Stardust, meteor showers, aurora nights, floor-is-lava and the 3 AM ghost

DEV DIARY

DAY 1First playable straight. The terrain held 60 fps on the first try — nobody trusted it.
DAY 3The traffic learned manners: bus routes, funerals, panic stops. The hearse was a stretch goal.
DAY 6Seasons shipped. Someone asked for snowmen; we also shipped pumpkins, just in case.
DAY 9100 stardust gems hidden along 70 km of road. The Nova followed them home.
NOWTen camera modes, 23 game modes, a 1000-item roadmap. Still counting. Still drifting.
